escena: SCENE (colour session at night, post studio in Bogota): the ONLY light in the room is the large calibration monitor in frame at the left edge, glowing cool azure blue — and that visible screen is what lights her: the blue falls across her cheek and the front of her sweater with a clear falloff into darkness on the far side of her face, and a small warm practical bulb sits far behind her, out of focus. She leans in to judge a frame, caught at the instant she tilts her head to compare. She wears a fine light heather-grey knit sweater; no navy or blue clothing. She looks at the monitor, never at the camera. 85mm lens at f/1.8, focus on her eyes. Everything is completely unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the colour-grading console, matte black with a felt top, immediately in front of the lens
lecho.tono: DARK near black, matte, with subtle texture
